scope: S9 real Lulu end-to-end via Daming's own lulu-service (health / capabilities / one signed-authorization submit). Loopback only.

luluBackend.note: Existing lulu dev Postgres volume password was unknown/drifted; an isolated throwaway pgvector container on 127.0.0.1:5444 was used only for this E2E. The existing lulu database was NOT modified. Backend and temp DB were stopped/removed after the run.

notes: Real model inference occurred through Lulu's configured providers during the single authorized submit (user-approved real side effect).
Daming-side submission is mediated by a signed one-time approval (operation/target/requestHash/expiry/nonce/signature) and an idempotent run store; the same nonce cannot be resent.

Offline package tests (8) cover offline/timeout/auth-failure never-fake-online, capabilities auth vs outage, and expiry/changed/tampered/wrong-target approval rejection plus status/evidence persistence.
Other Lulu environments require separate acceptance.
